title: Would you play this game?
author: OkDeal4527
selftext:
Haul and Hold: you grow your island from a hand of cards, your hero hauls wood and stone back to the keep himself, and bridges let you reach rival islands (and let them reach you). Then lead your armies, siege engines, to take enemy keeps.

How it's made: Godot 4.7, nearly all the code written by AI agents. Claude Code plans and reviews, Codex implements, every change goes through automated tests and an adversarial review before merging, and I review the visuals from my phone. The 3D models are CC0 packs (KayKit, Kenney); the sounds and music are AI-generated (ElevenLabs, Suno); the icon and splash are rendered from the game itself.

Play it here (phone or desktop, \~15 min for a Quick game): [https://haul-and-hold.vercel.app](https://haul-and-hold.vercel.app/)

I'd love honest feedback on the game itself, and happy to answer questions about the AI workflow.
